bus.lesion: a breast ultrasound image showing a mass

descriptive.normal: a breast ultrasound image showing normal tissue with no abnormalities
descriptive.benign: a breast ultrasound image showing a benign lesion
descriptive.malignant: a breast ultrasound image showing a malignant tumor

clinical.normal: breast ultrasound demonstrating homogeneous fat lobules and normal fibroglandular tissue with no focal lesions
clinical.benign: breast ultrasound showing a well-circumscribed oval homogeneous hypoechoic mass with parallel orientation consistent with a benign fibroadenoma
clinical.malignant: breast ultrasound demonstrating an irregular hypoechoic mass with angular margins spiculation and posterior acoustic shadowing suggestive of malignancy

descriptive.benign: a thyroid ultrasound image showing a benign nodule
descriptive.malignant: a thyroid ultrasound image showing a malignant nodule

clinical.benign: thyroid ultrasound showing a well-defined isoechoic or hyperechoic nodule with smooth margins and regular shape consistent with a benign colloid nodule
clinical.malignant: thyroid ultrasound demonstrating a solid hypoechoic nodule with irregular margins microcalcifications and taller-than-wide shape suggestive of papillary thyroid carcinoma

carrier_templates: breast ultrasound showing a mass with {d}
a breast ultrasound image of a lesion with {d}

pos: a left-sided position in the image
neg: a right-sided position in the image
